sentences.text: ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 1113 OF 2025 Swami Hansdev alias Hansraj and two Others ... Applicants

..... Respondent Counsel for the Applicants : Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya,
 Advocate Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Akshay Latwal, Assistant  Government Advocate with  Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, Brief  Holder.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

This Application has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.245 of 2025, registered at Kotwali Haridwar District Haridwar under Section 420 and Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
2.

According to the First Information Report dated 27.04.2025, Swami Shivram Das Trust,
Shivdham, Haridwar was registered under the provisions of the Societies Registration Act, 1860.
The renewal of the said Society was only till 16.09.2010.
On the basis of forged documents, the renewal of Society took place on 10.07.2024.

3. Heard Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Akshay Latwal,
learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondent.
4.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate submitted that the applicants are not named in the First Information Report.
They have been falsely implicated during the investigation.
The named co-accused Swami Ramdev and Gulshan Rai Narang have been granted interim bail by this Court in Anticipatory Bail Application No.987 of 2025.

5. Mr. Akshay Latwal, Assistant Government Advocate has sought time to file objection to the Swami Hansdev Alias Hansraj And Two ... vs State Of Uttarakhand on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29961619/
1 anticipatory bail application.
6.

sentences.text: 7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants, Swami Hansdev alias Hansraj, Som Nath Narang and Manohar Lal Khurana, they shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer,

subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;

(ii) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case;
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
8. List on 16.10.2025 along with the record of Anticipatory Bail Application No.987 of 2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
